definitions.explanation: To perceive through the senses or emotions.
To have an impression or opinion.

examples.english: After reading this book, I felt it was something important.

notes:
{感|かん}じる means to feel, sense, or perceive through emotions or physical sensations.

TRANSITIVITY:
Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes を for what is felt

ASPECT (ている):
{感|かん}じている indicates an ongoing state of feeling: {疲|つか}れを{感|かん}じている (I'm feeling tired).

PHYSICAL SENSATIONS:
- {痛|いた}みを{感|かん}じる: to feel pain
- {寒|さむ}さを{感|かん}じる: to feel cold
- {暑|あつ}さを{感|かん}じる: to feel heat

EMOTIONS:
- {喜|よろこ}びを{感|かん}じる: to feel joy
- {不安|ふあん}を{感|かん}じる: to feel anxiety
- {責任|せきにん}を{感|かん}じる: to feel responsibility

IMPRESSIONS (Sense 2):
When expressing opinions: [na-adj]に{感|かん}じる or [clause]と{感|かん}じる
- {不思議|ふしぎ}に{感|かん}じる: to find it strange
- {必要|ひつよう}だと{感|かん}じる: to feel it's necessary

RELATED WORDS:
- {感|かん}じ: feeling, impression (noun)
- {感覚|かんかく}: sense, sensation
- {感動|かんどう}する: to be moved/touched
